name: YouMod
subtitle: A YouTube tweak that recreates YTLite's features as closely as possible.
description:
AltStore source for YouMod — a lightweight YouTube enhancer for iOS and iPadOS.

YouMod adds downloading, appearance and player customization, tab bar reordering, built-in SponsorBlock, and much more. Originally created by Tonwalter888; IPA builds are produced by jaydenjcpy.

apps.name: YouMod
apps.subtitle: A lightweight YouTube enhancer
apps.localizedDescription:
A tweak that tries to recreate features like in YTLite as much as possible, plus alternative tweaks combined.

Features:
- Downloading (video, audio, captions, thumbnails, video details, and more — currently up to 1080p60)
- Appearance (OLED theme and keyboard)
- Navigation bar (hide buttons, sticky nav bar, custom logo)
- Player (hide elements and buttons, add custom actions)
- Shorts (hide elements, add custom actions, download button)
- Tab bar (reorder tabs, hide elements)
- Built-in SponsorBlock
- Copy video, comment and post information
- And much more!

Bundled tweaks: YouPiP, YTUHD, Return YouTube Dislikes, YTABConfig, DontEatMyContent, YTweaks, YouSlider.

YouMod preferences can be found in the YouTube settings.

YouMod v2.0.0

This release focuses on fixes, improvements, and adding a lot of new features to the tweak.

- Downloading: fixed videos that could not be saved to Photos, new progress dialog, download button in Shorts, more thumbnail options, copy comment and post info
- Navigation bar: sticky navigation bar option, more logo image options
- Appearance: fixed OLED theme not applying in some places, fixed colors not updating immediately
- Feed: fixed new types of ads not being removed, options to hide horizontal shelves
- Updated to YouTube 21.33.6
